info.name: NexTask API
info.description:
NexTask backend API collection.

1. Start server: npm run dev
2. Server runs on http://127.0.0.1:5001
3. Do NOT use port 5000 (macOS AirPlay blocks it)

Run Login or Register first — accessToken is saved automatically.
Workspace requests use Bearer auth. Create Workspace saves workspaceId for Get / Update / Delete.

request.description:
Creates a workspace. Slug is auto-generated from name if omitted.

Optional fields: slug, logo, ownerId, status (ACTIVE | ARCHIVED)
Visibility: PRIVATE | TEAM | PUBLIC
Returns workspaces owned by the authenticated user with pagination.
Get a single workspace. Requires owner access or PUBLIC visibility.

Update workspace fields. Only the owner can update.

Updatable: name, slug, description, logo, visibility, status
Permanently delete a workspace. Only the owner can delete.

Invite a user by email. Requires INVITE_MEMBERS permission (OWNER, ADMIN).

Sends a confirmation email with an accept link.
Assignable roles: ADMIN | MEMBER (OWNER is reserved for the creator).

query.description: Search by user name, username, or email

request.description: List members of a workspace. Requires workspace membership.
Get a single workspace member by member record ID.

Update a member role. Requires CHANGE_MEMBER_ROLE (OWNER, ADMIN).

Role hierarchy: OWNER > ADMIN > MEMBER.
You can only update members with a lower role than yours. Cannot change your own role or assign OWNER.

Remove a member. Requires REMOVE_MEMBERS to remove others (only lower roles).

Any member except OWNER can leave the workspace themselves.

Create a project inside a workspace. Requires CREATE_PROJECT (OWNER, ADMIN).

The creator is automatically added as the project OWNER.
Status: PLANNING | ACTIVE | ON_HOLD | COMPLETED

List projects in a workspace.

Workspace members see every project. Project-scoped members (invited to specific projects) see only the projects they belong to.
Get a single project by ID. Requires VIEW_PROJECT permission via workspace membership or a direct project membership.

Update project fields. Requires UPDATE_PROJECT (OWNER, ADMIN) — resolved from the effective project role (workspace or project membership).

Updatable: name, description, icon, status, startDate, endDate
Delete a project. Requires DELETE_PROJECT (OWNER, ADMIN) via effective project role. Also removes the project's members and pending invitations.

Invite a user by email to a single project. Requires INVITE_MEMBERS on the project (OWNER, ADMIN via effective project role).

Sends a confirmation email with an accept link. The invitee gets access to ONLY this project (not the whole workspace).
Assignable roles: ADMIN | MEMBER.

Rejected if the user already has access to the project (as a workspace member or an existing project member).

query.description: Search by user name, username, or email

request.description: List members of a project. Requires VIEW_MEMBERS (OWNER, ADMIN) via effective project role.
Get a single project member by member record ID. Requires VIEW_MEMBERS (OWNER, ADMIN).

Update a project member role. Requires CHANGE_MEMBER_ROLE (OWNER, ADMIN).

Role hierarchy: OWNER > ADMIN > MEMBER. You can only manage members with a lower role than yours. Cannot change your own role or assign OWNER.

Remove a project member. Requires REMOVE_MEMBERS to remove others (only lower roles).

Any project member except the project OWNER can leave the project themselves.
Create a board inside a project. Requires CREATE_BOARD (OWNER, ADMIN) via effective project role.
List boards in a project. Requires VIEW_PROJECT permission.
Get a single board by ID. Requires VIEW_PROJECT permission.

Update board fields. Requires UPDATE_BOARD (OWNER, ADMIN) via effective project role.

Updatable: name, description
Delete a board. Requires DELETE_BOARD (OWNER, ADMIN).

Create a column on a board. Requires CREATE_BOARD (OWNER, ADMIN) via effective project role.

Position is zero-based. Inserting at an existing position shifts other columns right.
List all columns for a board, sorted by position. Requires VIEW_PROJECT permission.
Get a single column by ID. Requires VIEW_PROJECT permission.

Update column fields. Requires UPDATE_BOARD (OWNER, ADMIN) via effective project role.

Updatable: name, position, color, isCompletedColumn. Only one completed column is allowed per board.
Delete a column. Requires DELETE_BOARD (OWNER, ADMIN). Remaining columns are re-indexed automatically.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Design homepage mockup",
  "columnId": "{{columnId}}",
  "description": "Create initial homepage wireframes and mockups",
  "priority": "HIGH",
  "assignees": [],
  "dueDate": "2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "labels": ["design", "frontend"]
}

request.description:
Create a task on a board. Requires CREATE_TASK.

columnId must belong to the board. reporterId defaults to the authenticated user.
Priority: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | URGENT
List tasks on a board. Requires VIEW_TASK permission.
Get a single task by ID. Requires VIEW_TASK permission.

Update task fields with granular permissions:
- UPDATE_TASK: title, description, dueDate, labels, reporterId
- MOVE_TASK: columnId
- ASSIGN_TASK: assignees
- CHANGE_TASK_PRIORITY: priority
- CHANGE_TASK_STATUS: completedAt

Moving to a completed column auto-sets completedAt.
Delete a task. Requires DELETE_TASK permission.
Preview invitation details using the token from the email link. No auth required.
Accept a workspace invitation. User must be logged in with the same email that received the invite.
Preview a project invitation using the token from the email link. Returns the project, workspace, role, and inviter. No auth required.
Accept a project invitation. User must be logged in with the same email that received the invite. Adds the user as a project-scoped member with access to only this project.
